story_type: kayaker stranded at the foot of a sea cliff, swimmer lowered, hoisted up to the overlook
hook: A kayaker stranded at the foot of a sea cliff.
narration: This kayaker got stranded at the bottom of a sea cliff, with the Pacific surging in around the rocks.
It was January 2016, at Devil's Punch Bowl State Park on the Oregon coast.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew came in low over the rocks.
Their rescue swimmer rode the cable down toward the waterline.
Climbing out over wet rock with surf pounding is how people get hurt, so the swimmer comes to them, clips them into a harness, and they ride up together.
[short pause] The hoist lifted them up the face and over the cliff edge.
From the ground, they swung under the helicopter against a clear blue sky.
outcome: The kayaker was set down safely at the scenic overlook, with no injuries.

location_card.place: Devil's Punch Bowl State Park, Oregon

title: Kayaker stranded below an Oregon cliff
description:
On Jan. 10, 2016, a Coast Guard rescue aircrew hoisted a stranded kayaker at Devil's Punch Bowl State Park, Oregon, and set the kayaker down at the park's scenic overlook with no injuries.
